objective: Stop projecting fake Skill Mastery Level 1/0 XP onto existing skills that have never entered system-growth:v1 tracking, while preserving real competency tiers and mapped German Growth.

roles_before.artifact: Explicit skill.upserted events own real competency tier/status.
system-growth:v1 assignments own whether a skill participates in Skill Mastery tracking.
buildGrowthProjection currently fabricates Mastery Level 1 / 0 XP fields for every explicit skill not present in Growth mappings.
PWA and player utility render Mastery for any skill carrying mastery fields/policy.
Neon/PostgreSQL remains the sole mutable owner; this defect is projection-only.
Git history is sufficient; no ledger mutation is required.

role_dispositions.destination: Existing verified tier/null competency and evidence stay untouched.
Only skills referenced by valid Growth mappings are mastery-tracked.
Explicit but unmapped skills expose mastery_tracked=false and null mastery metrics instead of invented Level 1 / 0 XP.
Render Mastery bar/section only when mastery_tracked=true; otherwise show competence without fake practice progression.
Projection-only code can be reverted without state migration.

capability_probes.assertion: Mapped German Language remains mastery_tracked=true with Level 1 and 0/50 XP before first verified mapped completion.
Turkish Tier 3 does not display or project a fake Mastery Level 1 / 0 XP merely because it exists as an explicit skill.
Marketplace Operations null competency does not display or project fake Mastery progress until a Growth mapping actually tracks it.
Real skill competency tier/evidence/status remain unchanged by mastery tracking semantics.
No player-state or ledger mutation is introduced.

tests.expected: unmapped explicit skills have mastery_tracked=false/null metrics; mapped skills retain v1 Mastery behavior.

tests.command: cd system/lifeup/cloud && node --test test/player-utility.test.mjs test/pwa-contract.test.mjs test/ui-polish.test.mjs
tests.expected: Mastery UI appears only for tracked skills; competency-only cards remain clear.
